## Episode Thesis

This is a politics episode with no investment content. Former Moderate leader Anna Kinberg Batra discusses Swedish government formation after 72 days of talks. Ulf Kristersson faces Monday's third of four possible prime minister votes for a four-party M/C/KD/L government without SD ministers. She puts the chance of a government on Monday at just over 50% and of a snap election at just under 50%. She argues the deadlock costs Sweden competitiveness through stalled AI, energy, space and research investment, while noting the stock market has largely ignored it.
